# Unit weights for tests/selftest.sh (A109): "<seconds> <suite> [scenario]", longest first.
# Generated by tests/selftest-weights.sh from 4 times file(s), 294 units; a unit seen in several files weighs the
# average of its seconds. Seconds are as measured under a 4-core CI shard; only the ratios matter.
# A unit that is not listed weighs the MEDIAN of the listed units. Shards are filled longest unit first onto the
# lightest shard; a stale weight only costs balance, it never drops or loosens a test.
# Refresh: download the selftest-times artifacts of a CI run, then sh tests/selftest-weights.sh <dir>.
# Seconds: the ubuntu-latest selftest jobs of main-push CI run 39479439384 (SELFTEST_SLOWEST=999 lists every unit); one run, not averaged.
